tracks.name: Checkride Flight - Lead
tracks.description: Start on the left side of this aircraft and follow the instructions.

messageEvents.text: Position your aircraft to my left
Check your livery and get ready to start your engines
Start taxi straight when Start Taxi is announced
Turn right and get on my right wing
This is our default way to taxi: taxi in groups as wingman
Speed to 15 knots on straights, 10 knots on turns
Keep in position while turning left
Back to 10 knots, prepare for turn
Remember to set power to 30% and brake on Get Ready sign
Position your aircraft on right side of runway, wingman position
Flaps 0 and pull up 15 degrees on end runway
Prepare to start leveling off 1,000 feet below 10,000
Try to stay close and stable in wingman position, on my right
I will announce checkpoint 3 by stating CP3
When I say GO we start left turn to Checkpoint 3
Keep close, prepare for CP4 and Trail formation
Stay in Trail formation, behind and a bit below me
When calling CP5, we'll turn left and go to Line Abreast formation
Fly Line Abreast formation, by flying on my right, cockpit next to mine
Prepare to turn left to CP6, back to Wingman formation
Stay at 400 knots, wingman position, 10,000 feet
We'll descend on our next turn to CP7, staying at 400 knots
Remember to start descending when turning left, 3000 feet per minute
Stay at 400 knots, 3000 feet per minute descend, wingman position
Roll out and level off at 7,500 feet
On our next checkpoint, we'll turn left, descend to 4000, 300 knots
Keep your relative position to my aircraft similar during the turn
Prepare to turn left and align runway, on CP9
Prepare for the overhead break over the runway
We'll fly 350 knots over the runway, you on my wingtip
When I say BREAK, I'll break TO THE RIGHT
4 seconds later, you break as well
Set flaps 1 and gear out when flying the base leg
Break by pulling up a few degrees, roll plane on the side and turn with 4 G
Use speedbrake to reduce speed to 200 knots and fly parralel to the runway after 180 degrees turn
Okay, stay close to me, we'll slowly increase speed to 350
Speed to 200 knots, altitude to 500 feet
Gear out and flaps 1 when stable at 200 knots
Lead turning final, follow my flight path, don't cut the corner
Flaps 2 on turn to final, check gear out
Reduce speed to 130 knots on touch down
Don't flare, we land navy style
Number 1 to left side of runway, go to right side of runway
Brake to 20 knots, turn left on next taxiway
Flaps up, go to wingman position on taxi
Runway clear, crossing it without braking
Park on my right hand side, go straight when I turn left and turn in later
Number 1 turning left, keep going straight for a few seconds
90 degrees turn, get ready to brake and park
Number 1 parked, position right next to me, park and turn of engine
